newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse dropped by 0.9 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse dropped by 0.9 pct in November.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index dropped by an average of 0.9 percent compared with its level the previous month, bourse statistics published on Friday showed.
The average index for November was 600.97, with the highest at 606.59 and the lowest at 588.97.
Total volume traded was 45 million dinars ($45 million), including 31 million dinars on the first market.
The average price of BTEI and Monoprix were down 17.21 percent each. BIAT eased 9.29 percent.
The average price of Le Moteur was up 18.99 percent, chemical firm ICF up 14.91 percent, and UBCI bank up 12.24 percent.
BIAT bank was the most traded for a total turnover of 9.35 million dinars, followed by Banque de l'Habitat with 3.69 million dinars, and STB bank for 1.90 million dinars.
On Friday December 13, the index closed at 592.51.
